answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique Upwork contract history. It rests on contracts completed with client feedback over years, which gives every honest agent a inlet that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so contracts completed with client feedback over years stays private; the canyon is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm doing the maths finds the dune first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
